title: a Page owner announces something, with a time on it

criteria.text: Only the managing role announces or edits; edit in place; deleting refused
criteria.note: Built: yes, except delete. `requireManagingRole` via `managingRoleForKind`; edit keeps the row id [V post.ts]. `group.post_delete` exists (soft delete, #318, Don 2026-10-02), so "deleting is refused" is no longer true; the scenario is not amended Checked: unmarked: `post.test.ts`, `PagePosts.test.tsx`.

criteria.text: Appears on Page and in browse as the Page's voice (no price, buy, listing chrome); past start drops out; undated leaves after 14 days to "Earlier", optional show-until, "Posted <date>"
criteria.note: Past-dated drop-out and "Posted <date>" on cards built (`browse_feed`, #258) [V]. Missing: 14-day expiry, "Earlier" section, show-until (`browse_feed` lets `starts_at is null` through forever [V migration]). Open #314. No-price/no-chrome: nothing asserts it Checked: unmarked: `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` (drop-out).

criteria.text: Optional date/time and own address; windowed read to the hour; undated never windowed; metro time
criteria.note: `starts_at`, `location_id` written (#183); `metro-time.ts` is the one zone, constant until #173 [V]; card lead in metro time (#258) Checked: unmarked: `metro-time.test.ts`, `post.test.ts`, `tests/announcement-card-db.test.ts`.

criteria.text: One audience switch, default anyone; words name people; no "announcement"/"bulletin" in a label; count in words at zero
criteria.note: `AudienceSwitch.tsx`: "Anyone", "Nobody yet" at zero [V]; restricted setting visible, not postable (delivery cut) Checked: unmarked: `PagePosts.test.tsx` (label test at :284; one component only).

criteria.text: A failed save leaves nothing behind
criteria.note: Place made before the post; insert in one transaction [V post.ts, build log] Checked: unmarked: `PagePosts.test.tsx:246`, `tests/page-post-db.test.ts` rollback.

criteria.text: Optional end time after start; add-to-calendar; default alt text from title, date, place; label "Event"
